clips.title: The story
paras: Wounded near the Pool of Ask'ar, Argent Guard Thaelrid is cut off in Blackfathom Deeps. The night elf scout entered the submerged ruins for the Argent Dawn, and now he has seen what gathers below.

Reports of foul rites beneath the sea reached the Argent Dawn from the Zoram Strand. The order watches for rising evils and unnatural corruption across Azeroth, so it sent Scout Thaelrid into Blackfathom Deeps. He was to judge the threat, watch the flooded temple, and report back. Then the Dawn could decide where aid was most needed.
